'''''The Clone Wars: Wild Space''''' is a novel inspired by ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' TV series, written by [[Karen Miller]]. [[The Clone Wars: Wild Space (audiobook)|The audio adaption]] of ''The Clone Wars: Wild Space'' was performed by [[Jeff Gurner]]. It was first published by [[Del Rey]] on [[December 9]], [[2008]] in paperback.
